title: US loses one-fourth of drone fleet as Iran war drains its arsenal: Report
excerpt: The US has lost at least 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones during the war with Iran around the Strait of Hormuz The losses valued at more than $13 billion have added to pressure on US weapons stocks and replenishment plans
content_html:
The skies around the Strait of Hormuz have become a costly operating zone for the US military. At least 45 MQ-9 Reaper drones have been lost during the war with Iran, according to The Washington Post. It amounts to roughly a quarter of the US fleet, which has been heavily used around the vital shipping route.

The Reaper is used for surveillance and targeted strikes. Each aircraft can cost between $30 million and $50 million, depending on its sensors and weapons. The value of the lost Reapers could exceed $1.3 billion.

According to the report, all of the aircraft were shot down. Some crashed after their operators lost communications links with the drones, the official said. The Reapers have been heavily deployed around the Strait of Hormuz. However, their relatively slow speed and low-altitude operations can leave them vulnerable to Iran's military and its regional proxies in Yemen and Iraq.

Before the conflict, the US military had about 185 Reapers, according to public budget data and military officials. The Air Force operated 165 of them, while the Marine Corps had 20.

None of the Marine Corps' Reapers have been lost, WaPo reported.

US DRONE FLEET UNDER PRESSURE

The Reaper losses add to mounting pressure on US weapons stocks, with the military already reportedly dealing with limited supplies of Patriot missile interceptors. In May, Lieutenant General David Tabor told the Senate that the number of remaining Air Force Reapers had fallen to about 135.

Tabor said he was "concerned" about the losses and that the Air Force was examining ways to replenish the fleet quickly. The Reaper is also part of a more extensive US weapons stockpile facing pressure from the Iran war and years of military support for Ukraine.

These shortages have complicated President Donald Trump's military options as tensions with Iran remain high. The Pentagon has repeatedly rejected claims that US weapons stocks are running low.

BILLIONS NEEDED TO REPLENISH STOCKPILES

The Trump administration is seeking congressional approval for a $67 billion supplemental package to cover the costs of the Iran war and replenish military supplies. Defence Secretary Pete Hegseth told senators in July that the Pentagon could be forced to reduce military training without additional funding.

He estimated that the Iran conflict would cost $37.5 billion through the end of September.

Even with new funding, rebuilding depleted weapons stocks could take years. The Pentagon is already phasing out the General Atomics-produced Reaper and plans to replace it with cheaper armed surveillance drones capable of operating in swarms.

With the Iran conflict showing no clear signs of ending, the Reaper losses add another challenge for a US military already under pressure to replenish its depleted arsenal.

content_html_zh:
霍尔木兹海峡周围的天空已成为美军成本高昂的行动区。 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，在与伊朗的战争中至少损失了 45 架 MQ-9 Reaper 无人机。 它约占美国船队的四分之一，这些船队在这条重要航线周围被大量使用。

收割者用于监视和有针对性的打击。 每架飞机的成本在 3000 万至 5000 万美元之间，具体取决于其传感器和武器。 失去的收割者的价值可能超过 13 亿美元。

报道称，所有飞机均被击落。 这位官员表示，有些无人机是在操作员与无人机失去通信联系后坠毁的。 “收割者”已大量部署在霍尔木兹海峡周围。 然而，它们相对较慢的速度和低空行动可能使它们容易受到伊朗军队及其在也门和伊拉克的地区代理人的攻击。

根据公共预算数据和军方官员的数据，冲突发生前，美军约有 185 架“收割者”。 空军拥有 165 架，海军陆战队拥有 20 架。

据《华盛顿邮报》报道，海军陆战队的“收割机”无人丢失。

美国无人机机队面临压力

“死神”导弹的损失给美国武器库存带来了越来越大的压力，据报道，军方已经在处理有限的爱国者导弹拦截弹供应。 5 月，戴维·塔博尔 (David Tabor) 中将告诉参议院，剩余的空军收割者人数已降至 135 人左右。

塔博尔表示，他对损失感到“担忧”，空军正在研究快速补充机队的方法。 “死神”也是美国更广泛武器库存的一部分，面临着伊朗战争和多年来对乌克兰的军事支持的压力。

由于与伊朗的紧张局势仍然严重，这些短缺使唐纳德·特朗普总统的军事选择变得复杂。 五角大楼一再否认美国武器库存不足的说法。

需要数十亿美元来补充库存

特朗普政府正在寻求国会批准一项价值 670 亿美元的补充计划，以支付伊朗战争的费用并补充军事物资。 国防部长皮特·赫格斯七月告诉参议员，如果没有额外资金，五角大楼可能被迫减少军事训练。

他估计，到 9 月底，伊朗冲突将造成 375 亿美元的损失。

即使有了新的资金，重建耗尽的武器库存也可能需要数年时间。 五角大楼已经在逐步淘汰通用原子公司生产的“死神”无人机，并计划用能够成群作战的更便宜的武装监视无人机取代它。

由于伊朗冲突没有明显结束的迹象，“死神”号的损失给已经面临补充其耗尽的军火库压力的美军带来了另一个挑战。
